verdict: Leads slowing this week; ad creative refresh is already underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 129 leads at an average cost of $11.20 per lead, with all paid activity running through Meta. This past week leads dropped roughly 19% compared to the prior week while cost per lead rose 24%, with spend held flat — the pattern points to audience fatigue on the top campaign rather than a budget issue, and ad creative is being refreshed this week to counter it. Separately, 129 leads entered your pipeline this period but only 98 moved into active opportunities, and no appointments were logged in the system — that gap is being reviewed with your intake process to make sure leads are being followed up before they go cold. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile activity fell sharply this week; a local presence push is being coordinated to stabilize that channel alongside the paid work. You should expect cost per lead to begin settling back down as the new creative takes hold over the next 7–10 days.
